verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own automatic user provisioning, so changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to third-party apps (docs-13/26). Dynamic groups (docs-30) can also drive attribute-based membership. Together these cover part of the app-by-app choreography when users change. However, nothing in the evidence shows event-triggered, no-code workflows for hire, role change and departure; Apps Script is a low-code developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: no-code workflow builder triggered by identity events, explicit joiner/mover/leaver workflow templates, multi-step orchestration beyond provisioning sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
